name: Broad-wallet launch range break
hypothesis: Buy above the completed early range only when cluster-adjusted buying breadth rises and the largest buyer share stays capped.
spec: Setup: A break supported by many small independent buyers may differ from one whale's price push. Entry: Buy above the completed early range only when cluster-adjusted buying breadth rises and the largest buyer share stays capped. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on range reentry or breadth collapse. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs launchpad creation events, bonding-curve state and decoded swaps (on-chain history not connected)
